annotations.title: Transfer a live call to the user

description:
Transfer a live call to the user's own phone so they can talk to the callee themselves, and get the transfer request confirmed. Compliance: the voice agent tells the callee it is handing over to the person it calls for; recommended whenever a payment or sensitive data is needed.

    The voice agent tells the callee it is passing the call over, rings user_phone_number, connects both sides without hanging up, then leaves the call. Use it only when the user asked to take over the conversation (or accepted when you offered) and can pick up their phone now. Fails if the call is not in progress. Follow progress with get_call: transfer events go requested → ringing → connected (or failed, in which case the voice agent stays on the line).

call_id.description: The call_id of the live call to hand over.
call_id.title: Call Id

user_phone_number.description: The user's own phone number to ring, French only (+33…, mobile 06/07 accepted), e.g. +33612345678.
user_phone_number.title: User Phone Number
